items.title: Lawrence Douglas Harris Interview, 1961-06-06
items.q: I had a fellow by the name of Jim Wiley who was colored Stewart and ran the place... We'd go down there and play three or four days at a time and stay right there in the place and eat and drink and sleep and play.

ctx.x: Look at that I made records, you don't believe it?

Yeah. I tell you another fellow was going good then when Dave had his band, a fellow by the name of Frank Davis. He was a drummer, marvelous drummer. And well Frank was getting a lot of work too and we were young and new in the business and Frank would get so much work he couldn't do it, he would throw it our way. That helped us to keep getting a lot of work too. And I remember making a picture, I never get to see that picture. They showed it there at the Queen Theater there in Houston. And we went out to this…
Oh yeah. Well when I left there I left there with Ida Cox.
